cheatNotes: - On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Hell Knight, Xiao Long, Dregan and Namira
- On the Character Select Screen, put the cursor on character who want to select the stage and press _S_S_S_S
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Koyasha, Mordos Kull and Takeshi
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Namira, Koyasha and Taria
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S Mordos Kull, Taria and Ragnar
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Xiao Long, Al' Rashid and Koyasha
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Ragnar, Al' Rashid and Takeshi
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Takeshi, Al' Rashid, Ragnar and Xiao Long
- On the Character Select Screen, press _S on Ichiro, Xiao Long and Koyasha
